verses.27:13: And it shall come to pass in that day that they shall sound the great trumpet, and those who were lost in the land of the Assyrians and those who were lost in Egypt shall come, and they shall worship the Lord upon the holy mountain Jerusalem.
verses.28:1: Woe to the crown of arrogance, you hirelings of Ephraim, the flower that has fallen from glory upon the summit of the rich mountain, you who are drunk without wine!
verses.28:2: Behold, strong and harsh is the wrath of the Lord, like descending hail that has no shelter, descending with violence; like a great multitude of water sweeping away a region, He shall make rest for the earth. With hands
verses.28:3: and with feet the crown of arrogance shall be trampled down, the hirelings of Ephraim.
verses.28:4: And the flower that has fallen from the hope of life upon the peak of the high mountain shall be like an early fig; he who sees it, before taking it into his hand, will desire to swallow it.
verses.28:5: In that day the Lord of hosts shall be the crown of hope woven of glory for the remnant of the people;
verses.28:6: they shall be left with a spirit of judgment for judgment and strength, hindering from slaying.
verses.28:7: For these have transgressed through wine; they have wandered because of strong drink. Priest and prophet have lost their senses because of strong drink; they have been swallowed up because of wine, they have been shaken by drunkenness, they have gone astray; this is an apparition.
verses.28:8: A curse shall devour this counsel, for this counsel is for the sake of covetousness.
verses.28:9: To whom have we declared evils, and to whom have we declared a message? Those who are weaned from milk, those who are drawn from the breast.
verses.28:10: Expect affliction upon affliction, hope upon hope, yet a little, yet a little,
verses.28:11: because of contempt of lips, through another tongue; for they shall speak to this people,
verses.28:12: saying to them, "This is the rest for the hungry, and this is the crushing," yet they were not willing to hear.
verses.28:13: And the oracle of the Lord shall be to them affliction upon affliction, hope upon hope, yet a little, yet a little, that they may go and fall backward, and they shall be crushed, and be in peril, and be captured.
verses.28:14: Therefore hear the word of the Lord, you afflicted men and rulers of this people who are in Jerusalem,
verses.28:15: because you have said, "We have made a covenant with Hades, and with death we have made agreements; if a rushing tempest passes through, it shall by no means come upon us; we have made falsehood our hope, and by falsehood we shall be sheltered."
verses.28:16: Therefore thus says the Lord, the Lord: "Behold, I set into the foundations of Zion a costly, chosen stone, an honored cornerstone, into her foundations; and he who believes shall by no means be put to shame.
verses.28:17: And I will set judgment for hope, and My mercy for balances; and you who trust vainly in falsehood, that a tempest may not pass over you,
verses.28:18: lest it also take away your covenant of death, yet your hope toward Hades shall by no means endure; if a rushing tempest comes upon you, you shall be trampled down by it.
verses.28:19: Whenever it passes through, it shall seize you; morning by morning it shall pass through by day, and in the night there shall be an evil hope."
verses.28:20: Learn to hear, you who are hard-pressed: "We are not able to fight, and we ourselves are too weak to be gathered together."
verses.28:21: Like a mountain of the ungodly the Lord shall rise up, and He shall be in the valley of Gibeon; with wrath He shall perform His works, a work of bitterness; and His wrath shall deal strangely, and His decay is strange.
verses.28:22: And may you not rejoice, nor let your bonds grow strong; for I have heard from the Lord of hosts things completed and cut short, which He shall perform upon all the earth.
verses.28:23: Give ear and hear my voice; pay heed and hear my words.
verses.28:24: Will the plowman plow all day long? Or will he prepare seed beforehand before working the ground?
verses.28:25: When he has leveled its surface, does he not then sow a little black cumin and cumin, and again sow wheat, barley, and millet, and spelt within your borders?
verses.28:26: And you shall be instructed by the judgment of God, and you shall rejoice.
verses.28:27: For black cumin is not cleansed with harshness, nor does a cartwheel roll over the cumin; but black cumin is shaken with a rod, and cumin
verses.28:28: shall be eaten with bread. For I will not be angry with you forever, nor shall the voice of My bitterness trample you down.
verses.28:29: And these wonders have come forth from the Lord of hosts: take counsel, lift up vain consolation.
verses.29:1: Woe to the city Ariel, which David fought against. Gather produce year upon year; you shall eat, for you shall eat with Moab.
verses.29:2: For I will distress Ariel, and her strength and wealth shall be Mine.
verses.29:3: And I will encircle you like David, and I will cast up a palisade around you, and I will set towers around you,
verses.29:4: and your words shall be brought low to the earth, and your words shall sink into the earth; and your voice shall be like those who call out from the earth, and toward the ground your voice shall grow faint.
verses.29:5: And the wealth of the ungodly shall be like dust from a wall, and the multitude of those who oppress you like chaff carried along; and it shall happen in an instant, suddenly,
verses.29:6: from the Lord of hosts; for there shall be a visitation with thunder and earthquake and a great voice, a rushing tempest and a flame of devouring fire.
verses.29:7: And the wealth of all the nations—all who marched against Jerusalem, and all who wage war against Jerusalem, and all who are gathered together against her and those who afflict her—shall be like one dreaming in sleep by night.
verses.29:8: And like those who drink and eat in sleep, and when they rise up the dream is vain; and just as a thirsty man dreams that he is drinking, and when he rises up he is still thirsty, and his soul has hoped in vain—so shall be the wealth of all the nations, all who marched against Mount Zion.
verses.29:9: Grow faint and be astounded; stagger in drunkenness, not from strong drink nor from wine;
verses.29:10: for the Lord has given you to drink of a spirit of stupor, and He shall close their eyes, and those of their prophets and of their rulers, who see hidden things.
verses.29:11: And all these words shall be to you like the words of the sealed book, which if they give it to a man who knows letters, saying, "Read these," he will say, "I cannot read, for it is sealed."
verses.29:12: And this book shall be given into the hands of a man who does not know letters, and one will say to him, "Read this," and he will say, "I do not know letters."
verses.29:13: And the Lord said, "This people draws near to Me with its mouth, and with their lips they honor Me, yet their heart keeps far away from Me; and in vain they revere Me, teaching precepts of men and doctrines.
verses.29:14: Therefore, behold, I will proceed to remove this people, and I will remove them; and I will destroy the wisdom of the wise, and the understanding of the discerning I will conceal."
verses.29:15: Woe to those who form counsel deeply, and their works shall be in darkness, and they will say, "Who has seen us? And who shall know us, or the things that we do?"
verses.29:16: Shall you not be reckoned as the clay of the potter? Shall the thing formed say to him who formed it, "You did not form me"? Or the thing made to him who made it, "You did not make me with understanding"?
verses.29:17: Not much longer, and Lebanon shall be changed like Mount Carmel, and Carmel shall be reckoned as a forest.
verses.29:18: And in that day the deaf shall hear the words of a book, and the eyes of the blind—those in darkness and those in mist—shall see;
verses.29:19: and the poor shall exult because of the Lord with gladness, and the despairing among men shall be filled with gladness.
verses.29:20: The lawless man has ceased, and the arrogant has perished, and those who act lawlessly for wickedness have been utterly destroyed,
verses.29:21: and those who cause men to sin by a word; and they shall make all who reprove in the gates a stumbling block, because they turned aside a righteous man with unjust deeds.
verses.29:22: Therefore thus says the Lord concerning the house of Jacob, whom He set apart from Abraham: "Not now shall Jacob be put to shame, nor shall he now change his countenance;
verses.29:23: but when their children see My works, for My sake they shall sanctify My name, and they shall sanctify the Holy One of Jacob, and they shall fear the God of Israel.
verses.29:24: And those who err in spirit shall know understanding, and those who murmur shall learn to obey, and the stammering tongues shall learn to speak peace."
verses.30:1: "Woe, rebellious children," says the Lord, "you have formed counsel not through Me, and covenants not through My Spirit, to add sins upon sins;
verses.30:2: those who proceed to go down into Egypt, yet have not inquired of Me, to be helped by Pharaoh and to be sheltered by the Egyptians.
verses.30:3: For the shelter of Pharaoh shall be shame to you, and a reproach to those who trust in Egypt.
verses.30:4: For in Tanis there are princes, evil messengers;
verses.30:5: in vain they shall toil for a people who will not profit them for help, but rather for shame and reproach."
verses.30:6: The vision of the four-footed beasts in the wilderness. In tribulation and distress are the lion and the lion's cub; from there also are asps and the offspring of asps; they carried their wealth upon donkeys and camels to a nation that will not profit them.
verses.30:7: The Egyptians shall profit you in vain and to no avail; declare to them, "This consolation of yours is vain."
verses.30:8: Now therefore, sit down and write these things upon a tablet and in a book, for these things shall be for days, in due time, and even forever.
verses.30:9: For this is a disobedient people, lying sons, who were not willing to hear the law of God,
verses.30:10: who say to the prophets, "Do not declare to us," and to those who see visions, "Do not speak to us, but speak to us and declare to us another deception,
verses.30:11: and turn us aside from this way; remove this path from us, and remove from us the oracle of Israel."
verses.30:12: Therefore thus says the Holy One of Israel: "Because you have disobeyed these words and have hoped in falsehood, and because you have murmured and placed your trust in this word,
verses.30:13: therefore this sin shall be to you like a suddenly falling wall of a captured fortified city, whose collapse comes in an instant;
verses.30:14: and its fall shall be like the shattering of an earthen vessel, fine fragments from a clay jar, so that among them no potsherd is found with which you may lift fire, or with which you may draw off a little water."
verses.30:15: Thus says the Lord, the Lord, the Holy One of Israel: "When you turn back and groan, then you shall be saved, and you shall know where you were; when you trusted in vain things, your strength became vain. Yet you were not willing to listen,
verses.30:16: but you said, 'We will flee upon horses'—therefore you shall flee!—and, 'We will be upon swift mounts'—therefore those who pursue you shall be swift.
verses.30:17: A thousand shall flee at the voice of one, and at the voice of five, many shall flee, until you are left like a mast upon a mountain, and like one bearing a banner upon a hill."
verses.30:18: And again God will wait to have compassion on you, and therefore He will be exalted to show mercy to you, because the Lord your God is a Judge; blessed are those who wait upon Him.
verses.30:19: For a holy people shall dwell in Zion; and Jerusalem wept with weeping, "Have mercy on me." He will have mercy on you; when He saw the voice of your cry, He heard you.
verses.30:20: And the Lord shall give you bread of affliction and scant water, and those who lead you astray shall no longer draw near to you; for your eyes shall see those who lead you astray,
verses.30:21: and your ears shall hear the words of those who led you astray from behind, who say, "This is the way; let us walk in it, whether to the right or to the left."
verses.30:22: And you shall defile the idols overlaid with silver and overlaid with gold; you shall crush them fine and scatter them like the water of a woman in her uncleanness, and you shall thrust them away like dung.
verses.30:23: Then there shall be rain for the seed of your land, and the bread of the produce of your land shall be abundant and rich; and your livestock shall graze in that day in a fertile and spacious place;
verses.30:24: your bulls and the oxen that till the ground shall eat chaff mixed with winnowed barley.
verses.30:25: And upon every high mountain and upon every lofty hill there shall be flowing water in that day, when many perish, when towers fall.
verses.30:26: And the light of the moon shall be as the light of the sun, and the light of the sun shall be sevenfold, in the day when the Lord heals the fracture of His people, and He shall heal the pain of your wound.
verses.30:27: Behold, the name of the Lord comes after a long time, burning wrath; with glory is the oracle of His lips, an oracle full of indignation, and the anger of His wrath shall devour like fire;
verses.30:28: and His breath, like rushing water in a ravine, shall reach even to the neck, and shall be divided to trouble the nations in vain deception; and deception shall pursue them and overtake them before their face.
verses.30:29: Must you always rejoice, and continually enter into My holy places as though keeping a feast, and as though rejoicing to enter with a flute into the mountain of the Lord, to the God of Israel?
verses.30:30: And the Lord shall make the glory of His voice heard, and display the wrath of His arm with wrath and anger and devouring flame, with a violent thunderbolt, and like water and hail swept down with force.
verses.30:31: For through the voice of the Lord the Assyrians shall be defeated, by the blow with which He strikes them.
verses.30:32: And it shall come upon him from every side, from where their hope of help was, in which he trusted; they themselves, with timbrels and harp, shall wage war against him in turn.
verses.30:33: For before your days you shall be called to account; has it also been prepared for you to reign—a deep ravine, logs laid out, fire and much wood? The wrath of the Lord is like a ravine kindled by brimstone.
verses.31:1: Woe to those who go down to Egypt for help, who trust in horses and in chariots—for they are many, and in horses an exceedingly great multitude—yet they did not trust in the Holy One of Israel, and they did not seek the Lord.
verses.31:2: Yet He Himself, being wise, brought evils upon them, and His word shall by no means be set aside; and He shall rise up against the houses of wicked men and against their vain hope,
verses.31:3: the Egyptian, a man and not God, the flesh of horses, and there is no help; but the Lord shall bring His hand upon them, and those who help shall grow weary, and all of them shall perish together.
verses.31:4: For thus the Lord spoke to me: "Just as the lion or the lion's cub roars over the prey that it has seized, and cries out over it until the mountains are filled with its voice, and they are defeated and terrified by the fullness of its fury, so shall the Lord of hosts descend to campaign upon Mount Zion, upon her mountains.
verses.31:5: Like flying birds, so the Lord of hosts shall shield; He shall defend Jerusalem and deliver it, and He shall preserve and save it."
verses.31:6: Turn back, O sons of Israel, who devise deep and lawless counsel.
verses.31:7: For in that day men shall renounce their silver images made by hand and their gold images made by hand, which their own hands made.
verses.31:8: And Assyria shall fall; neither the sword of a man nor the sword of a mortal shall devour him, and he shall flee, not from the face of a sword; and the young men shall come to defeat,
verses.31:9: for they shall be encompassed by a rock as by a palisade, and they shall be defeated; and he who flees shall be captured. Thus says the Lord: "Blessed is he who has seed in Zion and kinsmen in Jerusalem."
verses.32:1: For behold, a righteous king shall reign, and rulers shall rule with justice.
verses.32:2: And the man shall conceal his words, and he shall be hidden as from rushing water; and he shall appear in Zion like a glorious rushing river in a thirsty land.
verses.32:3: And they shall no longer be trusting in men, but they shall give their ears to hear;
verses.32:4: and the heart of the weak shall give heed to hear, and the stammering tongues shall quickly learn to speak peace;
verses.32:5: and they shall no longer tell the fool to rule, and your servants shall no longer say, "Be silent!"
verses.32:6: For the fool shall speak foolish things, and his heart shall devise vain things, to accomplish lawless deeds and to speak error against the Lord, to scatter hungry souls, and he shall leave the thirsty souls empty.
verses.32:7: For the counsel of the wicked shall devise lawless things, to destroy the humble with unjust words and to scatter the words of the humble in judgment.
verses.32:8: But the godly have devised prudent things, and this counsel shall abide.
verses.32:9: Wealthy women, rise up and hear my voice; daughters in hope, listen to my words.
verses.32:10: Make remembrance of a day of a year in pain with hope; the vintage has been consumed, it has ceased, and shall never come again.
verses.32:11: Be dismayed, be grieved, you who are confident; strip yourselves, become bare, gird your loins,
verses.32:12: and beat upon your breasts, because of the desirable field and the produce of the vine.
verses.32:13: As for the land of my people, thorns and grass shall come up, and gladness shall be taken away from every house;
verses.32:14: O wealthy city, forsaken houses shall abandon the wealth of the city, the desirable houses; and the villages shall be caves forever, the delight of wild donkeys, pastures of shepherds,
verses.32:15: until the Spirit from on high comes upon you. And Carmel shall be a wilderness, and Carmel shall be reckoned as a forest.
verses.32:16: And judgment shall rest in the wilderness, and righteousness shall dwell in Carmel;
verses.32:17: and the works of righteousness shall be peace, and righteousness shall maintain rest, and they shall be confident forever;
verses.32:18: and His people shall dwell in a city of peace, and shall abide in confidence, and they shall rest with wealth.
verses.32:19: And if the hail comes down, it shall not come upon you. And those who dwell in the forests shall be confident, as in the plain.
verses.32:20: Blessed are those who sow beside every water, where the ox and the donkey tread.
verses.33:1: Woe to those who afflict you, yet no one makes you miserable; and he who rejects you does not reject. Those who reject shall be captured and delivered up, and like a moth upon a garment, so shall they be defeated.
verses.33:2: O Lord, have mercy on us, for in You we have trusted; the seed of the disobedient has come to destruction, yet our salvation is in a time of tribulation.
verses.33:3: Because of the voice of terror, peoples were dismayed at the fear of You, and the nations were scattered.
verses.33:4: And now your spoil shall be gathered, both of small and great; just as when one gathers a locust, so shall they mock you.
verses.33:5: Holy is God who dwells on high; Zion has been filled with judgment, and in righteousness
verses.33:6: in the law they shall be delivered up. Our salvation is in treasures; wisdom and understanding and godliness toward the Lord have come; these are treasures of righteousness.
verses.33:7: Behold now, in your fear these shall be afraid; those whom you feared shall cry out because of you; messengers shall be sent forth weeping bitterly, pleading for peace.
verses.33:8: For their ways shall be made desolate; the fear of the nations has ceased, and the covenant with them is taken away, and you shall by no means regard them as men.
verses.33:9: The earth mourned, Lebanon was put to shame, Sharon became marshes; Galilee and Carmel shall be made manifest.
verses.33:10: "Now I will arise," says the Lord; "now I will be glorified, now I will be exalted;
verses.33:11: now you shall see, now you shall perceive; the strength of your spirit shall be in vain; fire shall devour you,
verses.33:12: and nations shall be burned completely, like a thorn cast out in a field and burned completely.
verses.33:13: Those who are afar off shall hear what I have done; those who draw near shall know My strength."
verses.33:14: The lawless in Zion have turned away; trembling shall seize the ungodly. Who will declare to you that fire is burning? Who will declare to you the eternal place?
verses.33:15: He who walks in righteousness, speaking of a straight way, hating lawlessness and unrighteousness, and shaking his hands from bribes, stopping his ears lest he hear a judgment of blood, shutting his eyes lest he see unrighteousness,
verses.33:16: this one shall dwell in a lofty cave of a strong rock; bread shall be given to him, and his water is sure.
verses.33:17: You shall see a king with glory; your eyes shall behold a land from afar.
verses.33:18: Our soul shall meditate on fear: Where are the scribes? Where are the counselors? Where is he who numbers those who are nourished,
verses.33:19: a small and great people? With whom he did not take counsel, nor did he know one of deep speech, so that a despised people might not hear, and there is no understanding for the one who hears.
verses.33:20: Behold Zion the city, our salvation; your eyes shall see Jerusalem, a wealthy city, tents that shall never be shaken, nor shall the stakes of her tent be moved forever, nor shall her cords ever be broken;
verses.33:21: for the name of the Lord is great to you. There shall be a place for you, rivers and canals broad and spacious; you shall not travel this way, nor shall a rowing vessel pass.
verses.33:22: For my God is great; He will not pass me by. The Lord is our Judge, the Lord is our Ruler, the Lord is our King; the Lord Himself will save us.
verses.33:23: Your cords were broken, for they were not strong; your mast leaned over; it shall not let down the sails, it shall not raise a banner, until it is delivered up to plunder; therefore many who are lame shall take plunder.
verses.33:24: And the people dwelling among them shall by no means say, "I am weary," for their sin has been forgiven them.
verses.34:1: Draw near, O nations, and listen, O rulers; let the earth hear and those who are in it, the inhabited world and the people who are in it.
verses.34:2: For the fury of the Lord is upon all the nations, and wrath is upon their number, to destroy them and deliver them up to slaughter.
verses.34:3: And their wounded shall be cast out, and the dead, and their stench shall rise up, and the mountains shall be drenched with their blood.
verses.34:4: And all the powers of the heavens shall melt away, and the heaven shall be rolled up like a scroll; and all the stars shall fall like leaves from a vine, and as leaves fall from a fig tree.
verses.34:5: My sword has been made drunk in heaven; behold, it shall come down upon Idumea, and upon the people of destruction with judgment.
verses.34:6: The sword of the Lord has been filled with blood; it has been thickened with fat, with the blood of goats and lambs, and with the fat of goats and rams. For there is a sacrifice to the Lord in Bozrah, and a great slaughter in Idumea,
verses.34:7: and the mighty ones shall fall together with them, both the rams and the bulls; and the land shall be made drunk with the blood, and with their fat it shall be filled.
verses.34:8: For it is the day of the judgment of the Lord, and a year of recompense for the judgment of Zion.
verses.34:9: And her ravines shall be turned into pitch, and her land into brimstone; and her land shall be like pitch burning
verses.34:10: night and day, and it shall not be quenched forever; and her smoke shall ascend upward; throughout her generations she shall be made desolate, and for a long time.
verses.34:11: Birds and hedgehogs and ibises and ravens shall dwell in her; and a measuring cord of desert shall be cast over her, and onocentaurs shall inhabit her.
verses.34:12: Her rulers shall be no more, for her kings and her nobles shall come to destruction.
verses.34:13: And thorny trees shall spring up in their cities and in her strongholds, and she shall become dwellings of sirens and a court of ostriches;
verses.34:14: and demons shall meet with onocentaurs, and they shall cry out one to another; there onocentaurs shall rest, having found rest for themselves.
verses.34:15: There the hedgehog made its nest, and the earth preserved her young in safety; there deer met together and saw one another's faces.
verses.34:16: By number they passed by, and not one of them perished; one did not seek another, for the Lord commanded them, and His Spirit gathered them together.
verses.34:17: And He Himself shall cast lots for them, and His hand apportioned it for grazing; forever you shall inherit it; for generations of generations they shall rest upon it.
verses.35:1: Be glad, O thirsty wilderness; let the wilderness exult and blossom like a lily,
verses.35:2: and the waste places of the Jordan shall burst into bloom and exult. The glory of Lebanon has been given to her, and the honor of Carmel; and My people shall see the glory of the Lord and the majesty of God.
verses.35:3: Be strong, O drooping hands and paralyzed knees;
verses.35:4: Take courage, you who are fainthearted in mind; be strong, do not fear. Behold, our God renders judgment and will recompense; He Himself will come and save us.
verses.35:5: Then the eyes of the blind shall be opened, and the ears of the deaf shall hear.
verses.35:6: Then the lame shall leap like a deer, and the tongue of the stammerers shall be clear; for water has burst forth in the wilderness, and a ravine in a thirsty land,
verses.35:7: and the waterless place shall become marshes, and in the thirsty land there shall be a spring of water; there shall be gladness of birds, dwellings of reeds and marshes.
verses.35:8: A clean way shall be there, and it shall be called a holy way; and no unclean one shall pass through there, nor shall there be an unclean way there; but the dispersed shall walk upon it, and shall by no means go astray.
verses.35:9: And no lion shall be there, nor shall any of the evil beasts go up upon it, nor shall any be found there; rather, the redeemed shall walk in it
verses.35:10: and those gathered together on account of the Lord; and they shall return and come to Zion with gladness, and everlasting gladness shall be upon their head—praise and exultation—and gladness shall overtake them; pain and sorrow and sighing have fled away.
verses.36:1: And it came to pass in the fourteenth year of the reign of Hezekiah that Sennacherib king of the Assyrians went up against the fortified cities of Judea and took them.
verses.36:2: And the king of the Assyrians sent Rabshakeh from Lachish to Jerusalem to King Hezekiah with a great army; and he stood by the aqueduct of the upper pool, on the road of the fuller's field.
verses.36:3: And there went out to him Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, the steward, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah the son of Asaph, the recorder.
verses.36:4: And Rabshakeh said to them, "Say to Hezekiah, 'Thus says the great king, the king of the Assyrians: In what are you trusting?
verses.36:5: Is battle waged by counsel and words of the lips? And now, in whom do you trust, that you disobey me?
verses.36:6: Behold, you are trusting in this crushed staff of reed, in Egypt; whoever leans upon it, it shall enter into his hand. So is Pharaoh king of Egypt, and all who trust in him.'
verses.36:7: But if you say, 'We trust in the Lord our God,'
verses.36:8: now join yourselves to my master the king of the Assyrians, and I will give you two thousand horses, if you are able to put riders upon them.
verses.36:9: And how can you turn back before the face of the governors? Household servants are those who trust in Egypt for horse and rider.
verses.36:10: And now, have we come up without the Lord against this country to make war against it? The Lord said to me, 'Go up against this land and destroy it.'"
verses.36:11: Then Eliakim and Shebna and Joah said to him, "Speak to your servants in Syriac, for we understand it; and do not speak to us in Judean. And why do you speak in the ears of the people on the wall?"
verses.36:12: And Rabshakeh said to them, "Has my master sent me to your master or to you to speak these words? Is it not to the people sitting on the wall, that they may eat dung and drink urine together with you?"
verses.36:13: Then Rabshakeh stood and cried out with a loud voice in Judean and said, "Hear the words of the great king, the king of the Assyrians:
verses.36:14: Thus says the king: Do not let Hezekiah deceive you with words; he shall by no means be able to deliver you.
verses.36:15: And do not let Hezekiah say to you, 'God will deliver you, and this city shall by no means be given into the hand of the king of the Assyrians.'
verses.36:16: Do not listen to Hezekiah. Thus says the king of the Assyrians: If you wish to be blessed, come out to me, and each one of you shall eat from his own vine and the fig trees, and you shall drink water from your bronze vessel,
verses.36:17: until I come and take you to a land like your own land, a land of grain and wine and bread and vineyards.
verses.36:18: Do not let Hezekiah deceive you, saying, 'God will deliver you.' Have the gods of the nations delivered, each one his own country, out of the hand of the king of the Assyrians?
verses.36:19: Where is the god of Hamath and Arpad? And where is the god of the city of Eppharuaim? Were they able to deliver Samaria out of my hand?
verses.36:20: Who among all the gods of these nations is there who has delivered his land out of my hand, that God should deliver Jerusalem out of my hand?"
verses.36:21: And they kept silent, and no one answered him a word, because the king had commanded that no one should answer.
verses.36:22: Then Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, the steward, and Shebna the scribe of the army, and Joah the son of Asaph, the recorder, came in to Hezekiah with their tunics torn, and reported to him the words of Rabshakeh.
verses.37:1: And it came to pass, when King Hezekiah heard it, that he tore his garments and put on sackcloth, and went up into the house of the Lord.
verses.37:2: And he sent Eliakim the steward, and Shebna the scribe, and the elders of the priests, clothed in sackcloth, to Isaiah the son of Amoz, the prophet.
verses.37:3: And they said to him, "Thus says Hezekiah: This day is a day of distress and reproach and rebuke and wrath; for the pang of childbirth has come upon her who is in labor, yet she has no strength to bring forth.
verses.37:4: May the Lord your God hear the words of Rabshakeh, which the king of the Assyrians sent to reproach the living God and to speak words of reproach which the Lord your God has heard; and you shall pray to your Lord for these who remain."
verses.37:5: So the servants of King Hezekiah came to Isaiah.
verses.37:6: And Isaiah said to them, "Thus you shall say to your master, 'Thus says the Lord: Do not be afraid because of the words which you have heard, with which the envoys of the king of the Assyrians have reproached Me.
verses.37:7: Behold, I will put a spirit into him, and when he hears a report, he shall return to his own country, and he shall fall by the sword in his own land.'"
verses.37:8: Then Rabshakeh returned and found the king of the Assyrians besieging Libnah, and he heard that he had departed from Lachish.
verses.37:9: And Tirhakah king of the Ethiopians went out to besiege him; and when he heard of it, he turned back and sent messengers to Hezekiah, saying,
verses.37:10: "Thus you shall say to Hezekiah king of Judea: Do not let your God in whom you trust deceive you, saying, 'Jerusalem shall by no means be given into the hand of the king of the Assyrians.'
verses.37:11: Have you not heard what the kings of the Assyrians have done to all the earth, how they destroyed it? And shall you be delivered?
verses.37:12: Have the gods of the nations delivered those whom my fathers destroyed—Gozan and Haran and Rapheth, which are in the land of Theemath?
verses.37:13: Where are the kings of Hamath, and where are those of Arpad, and of the city of Eppharuaim, Anag, and Ugaua?"
verses.37:14: And Hezekiah received the letter from the messengers and read it; and he went up to the house of the Lord and opened it before the Lord.
verses.37:15: And Hezekiah prayed to the Lord, saying,
verses.37:16: "O Lord of hosts, God of Israel, who sits upon the cherubim, You alone are God of every kingdom of the world; You have made heaven and earth.
verses.37:17: Incline Your ear, O Lord; hear, O Lord! Open Your eyes, O Lord; look, O Lord, and see the words of Sennacherib, which he has sent to reproach the living God.
verses.37:18: Truly, the kings of the Assyrians have laid waste the whole world and their land,
verses.37:19: and have cast their idols into the fire; for they were not gods, but the works of men's hands, wood and stone, and they cast them away.
verses.37:20: Now therefore, O Lord our God, save us out of his hand, that every kingdom of the earth may know that You alone are God."
verses.37:21: Then Isaiah the son of Amoz was sent to Hezekiah and said to him, "Thus says the Lord God of Israel: I have heard what you have prayed to Me concerning Sennacherib king of the Assyrians.
verses.37:22: This is the word which God has spoken concerning him: The virgin daughter of Zion has despised you and mocked you; the daughter of Jerusalem has shaken her head at you.
verses.37:23: Whom have you reproached and provoked? And against whom have you raised your voice? And have you not lifted up your eyes on high against the Holy One of Israel?
verses.37:24: For through messengers you have reproached the Lord; for you have said, 'With the multitude of chariots I have gone up to the height of the mountains, and to the farthest reaches of Lebanon; and I have cut down the height of its cedar and the beauty of the cypress, and I have entered into the height of a part of the forest,
verses.37:25: and I have laid a bridge, and I have laid waste the waters and every gathering of water.'
verses.37:26: Have I not heard long ago these things which I have done? From ancient days I ordained it, and now I have shown it, to lay waste nations in strongholds and those who dwell in fortified cities.
verses.37:27: I weakened their hands, and they withered away, and became like dry grass on the housetops and like wild grass.
verses.37:28: But now I know your resting, and your going out, and your coming in.
verses.37:29: And your fury with which you have raged, and your bitterness, have come up to Me; and I will put a muzzle in your nose and a bridle in your lips, and I will turn you back by the way by which you came.
verses.37:30: And this shall be the sign to you: eat this year what you have sown, and in the second year what remains; and in the third year sow and reap, and plant vineyards, and you shall eat their fruit.
verses.37:31: And there shall be those who remain in Judea; they shall put forth root downward and produce seed upward.
verses.37:32: For out of Jerusalem shall come those who remain, and those who are saved out of Mount Zion; the zeal of the Lord of hosts shall do these things.
verses.37:33: Therefore thus says the Lord concerning the king of the Assyrians: He shall by no means enter into this city, nor shoot an arrow against it, nor bring a shield against it, nor surround it with a siege rampart;
verses.37:34: but by the way by which he came, by the same he shall return, and into this city he shall by no means enter. Thus says the Lord:
verses.37:35: I will defend this city to save it, for My own sake and for the sake of My servant David."
verses.37:36: Then an angel of the Lord went out and slew one hundred and eighty-five thousand from the camp of the Assyrians; and when they rose in the morning, they found all the bodies dead.
verses.37:37: So Sennacherib king of the Assyrians turned back and departed, and dwelt in Nineveh.
verses.37:38: And while he was worshiping in the house of Nisroch his ancestral deity, Adrammelech and Sharezer his sons struck him down with swords; and they escaped into Armenia. And Esarhaddon his son reigned in his place.
verses.38:1: Now it came to pass in that time that Hezekiah fell sick to the point of death; and Isaiah the son of Amoz, the prophet, came to him and said to him, "Thus says the Lord: 'Set your house in order, for you are dying and shall not live.'"
verses.38:2: Then Hezekiah turned his face toward the wall and prayed to the Lord,
verses.38:3: saying, "Remember, O Lord, how I have walked before You with truth in a true heart, and have done what is pleasing before You." And Hezekiah wept with a great weeping.
verses.38:4: And the word of the Lord came to Isaiah, saying,
verses.38:5: "Go and say to Hezekiah, 'Thus says the Lord, the God of David your father: I have heard your prayer and I have seen your tears; behold, I add fifteen years to your time.
verses.38:6: And out of the hand of the king of the Assyrians I will deliver you and this city, and I will shield this city.
verses.38:7: And this shall be the sign to you from the Lord, that God will perform this word:
verses.38:8: behold, I turn back the shadow of the steps—the ten steps of the house of your father down which the sun has gone—I will turn back the sun the ten steps.'" And the sun went up the ten steps which the shadow had gone down.
verses.38:9: The prayer of Hezekiah king of Judea, when he had fallen sick and rose up from his sickness:
verses.38:10: I said, "In the height of my days, at the gates of Hades, I shall leave behind the remaining years."
verses.38:11: I said, "No longer shall I see the salvation of God in the land of the living; no longer shall I see the salvation of Israel upon the earth; no longer shall I see man."
verses.38:12: It failed from my kindred; I left behind the remainder of my life; it went out and departed from me like one who takes down a tent he has pitched; my spirit within me became like the web of a weaver drawing near to cut it off.
verses.38:13: In that day I was given over until morning as to a lion; it crushed all my bones, for from day until night I was given over.
verses.38:14: Like a swallow, so shall I cry out, and like a dove, so I murmur; for my eyes failed from looking into the height of heaven toward the Lord, who delivered me
verses.38:15: and took away the pain of my soul.
verses.38:16: O Lord, for it was told to You concerning it, and You revived my breath, and being comforted, I lived.
verses.38:17: For You chose my soul, that it should not perish, and You cast behind me all my sins.
verses.38:18: For those in Hades shall not praise You, nor shall those who have died bless You, nor shall those in Hades hope for Your mercy.
verses.38:19: The living shall bless You, in the same manner as I also do; for from this day I shall father children, who shall declare Your righteousness,
verses.38:20: O God of my salvation! And I shall not cease blessing You with a psaltery all the days of my life before the house of God.
verses.38:21: And Isaiah said to Hezekiah, "Take a cake of figs and crush it and apply it as a poultice, and you shall be well."
verses.38:22: And Hezekiah said, "This is a sign to Hezekiah that I shall go up to the house of God."
verses.39:1: In that time Merodach-Baladan the son of Baladan, the king of Babylonia, sent letters and envoys and gifts; for he had heard that he had fallen sick to the point of death and had risen up.
verses.39:2: And Hezekiah rejoiced over them, and showed them the house of Nechotha, and of the silver, and of the gold, and of the oil of myrrh, and of the incense, and of the ointment, and all the houses of the vessels of the treasure, and all that was in his treasuries; and there was nothing in his house that Hezekiah did not show.
verses.39:3: And Isaiah the prophet came to King Hezekiah and said to him, "What do these men say, and from where have they come to you?" And Hezekiah said, "From a land far away they have come to me, from Babylon."
verses.39:4: And Isaiah said, "What did they see in your house?" And Hezekiah said, "All the things in my house they saw, and there is nothing in my house that they did not see, yes, even the things in my treasuries."
verses.39:5: And Isaiah said to him, "Hear the word of the Lord of Sabaoth:
verses.39:6: 'Behold, days are coming when they shall take all that is in your house, and whatever your fathers have gathered until this day shall come to Babylon, and they shall by no means leave anything behind,' and God has said,
verses.39:7: 'Even some of your children whom you shall father they shall take, and they shall make them eunuchs in the house of the king of the Babylonians.'"
verses.39:8: And Hezekiah said to Isaiah, "Good is the word of the Lord which He has spoken; let there indeed be peace and righteousness in my days."
verses.40:2: O priests, speak to the heart of Jerusalem, comfort her, because her humiliation has been fulfilled; her sin has been remitted, for she has received from the hand of the Lord double for her sins.
verses.40:3: A voice of one crying out in the wilderness: "Prepare the way of the Lord; make straight the paths of our God.
verses.40:4: Every valley shall be filled up, and every mountain and hill shall be brought low; and all the crooked places shall become a straight path, and the rough way into level plains,
verses.40:5: and the glory of the Lord shall appear, and all flesh shall see the salvation of God; for the Lord has spoken."
verses.40:6: A voice of one saying, "Cry out!" And I said, "What shall I cry?" "All flesh is grass, and all the glory of man is like a flower of the grass.
verses.40:7: The grass has withered, and the flower has fallen away,
verses.40:8: but the word of our God abides forever."
verses.40:9: Go up upon a high mountain, you who bring good tidings to Zion; lift up your voice with strength, you who bring good tidings to Jerusalem; lift it up, do not be afraid; say to the cities of Judah, "Behold your God!"
verses.40:10: Behold, the Lord, the Lord comes with strength, and His arm with dominion; behold, His reward is with Him, and His work before Him.
verses.40:11: Like a shepherd He shall tend His flock, and with His arm He shall gather the lambs, and those who are with young He shall comfort.
verses.40:12: Who has measured the water in the hand, and heaven by a span, and all the earth by a handful? Who has weighed the mountains in a balance and the valleys on a scale?
verses.40:13: Who has known the mind of the Lord, and who has become His counselor, who shall instruct Him?
verses.40:14: Or with whom did He take counsel, that he instructed Him? Or who showed Him judgment? Or who showed Him the way of understanding?
verses.40:15: If all the nations have been reckoned as a drop from a bucket and as the tipping of a scale, they shall be reckoned as spittle;
verses.40:16: and Lebanon is not sufficient for burning, nor are all the four-footed beasts sufficient for a whole burnt offering,
verses.40:17: and all the nations are as nothing, and as nothingness they have been reckoned.
verses.40:18: To whom have you likened the Lord, and to what likeness have you likened Him?
verses.40:19: Did a craftsman make an image, or did a goldsmith melt gold and overlay it with gold? Did he fashion it as a likeness?
verses.40:20: For a craftsman chooses wood that will not rot, and skillfully he will seek how to set up an image of it so that it may not be shaken.
verses.40:21: Will you not know? Will you not hear? Was it not declared to you from the beginning? Have you not known the foundations of the earth?
verses.40:22: It is He who holds fast the circle of the earth, and those who dwell in it are like locusts; who has established heaven like a vault and stretched it out like a tent to dwell in,
verses.40:23: who gives rulers to rule as nothing, and has made the earth as nothing.
verses.40:24: For they shall by no means plant, nor shall they sow, nor shall their root take root in the earth; He has blown upon them and they withered, and a tempest shall carry them away like brushwood.
verses.40:25: "Now therefore, to whom have you likened Me, and I shall be exalted?" said the Holy One.
verses.40:26: Lift up your eyes on high and behold: who has displayed all these things? He who brings forth His ordered host by number shall call them all by name by reason of great glory, and in the might of strength nothing has escaped You.
verses.40:27: For do not say, O Jacob—and why did you speak, O Israel—"My way has been hidden from God, and my God has taken away judgment and departed"?
verses.40:28: And now, have you not known? Have you not heard? God everlasting, the God who fashioned the ends of the earth, shall neither hunger nor grow weary, nor is there any searching out of His understanding,
verses.40:29: giving strength to those who hunger, and sorrow to those who are not in pain.
verses.40:30: For younger men shall hunger, and youths shall grow weary, and chosen men shall be without strength;
verses.40:31: but those who wait upon God shall renew their strength; they shall sprout wings like eagles; they shall run and not grow weary; they shall walk and not hunger.
verses.41:1: Be renewed before Me, O islands, for the rulers shall renew their strength; let them draw near and speak together; then let them declare judgment.
verses.41:2: Who has raised up righteousness from the east, called it to His feet, and it shall go forth? He shall deliver it before the nations and dismay kings; and He shall give their swords to the earth, and their bows like driven brushwood;
verses.41:3: and He shall pursue them; the way of His feet shall pass through in peace.
verses.41:4: Who has worked and done these things? He has called it, who calls it from the generations of the beginning; I am God, the first, and for the things to come, I am.
verses.41:5: The nations saw and were afraid; the ends of the earth drew near and came together,
verses.41:6: each one deciding to help his neighbor and his brother, and he will say,
verses.41:7: "The craftsman has grown strong, and the coppersmith striking with the hammer, forging at the same time." At times he will say, "It is a good joining"; he has fastened them with nails; they shall set them up, and they shall not be moved.
verses.41:8: But you, Israel, My servant, Jacob whom I have chosen, the seed of Abraham whom I have loved,
verses.41:9: whom I took hold of from the ends of the earth, and from its watchtowers I called you and said to you, "You are My servant; I have chosen you and have not forsaken you."
verses.41:10: Do not fear, for I am with you; do not go astray, for I am your God who has strengthened you; and I have helped you, and I have made you secure with My righteous right hand.
verses.41:11: Behold, all who oppose you shall be ashamed and disgraced; for they shall be as nothing, and all your adversaries shall perish.
verses.41:12: You shall seek them and shall by no means find the men who will act insolently against you; for they shall be as nothing, and those who wage war against you shall not be.
verses.41:13: For I am your God, who holds your right hand, who says to you,
verses.41:14: "Do not fear, Jacob, tiny Israel; I have helped you," says God, who redeems Israel.
verses.41:15: Behold, I have made you like new saw-toothed threshing wheels of a wagon, and you shall thresh mountains and grind hills fine, and make them like chaff;
verses.41:16: and you shall winnow them, and the wind shall carry them away, and a tempest shall scatter them. But you shall rejoice in the holy ones of Israel,
verses.41:17: and the poor and the needy shall exult. For they shall seek water, and there shall be none; their tongue has been parched with thirst. I, the Lord God, the God of Israel, will hear them and will not forsake them,
verses.41:18: but I will open rivers upon the mountains and springs in the midst of plains; I will turn the wilderness into pools of water and the thirsty land into watercourses.
verses.41:19: I will set in the waterless land the cedar and the box tree, the myrtle and the cypress and the white poplar,
verses.41:20: that they may see and know, and consider and understand together, that the hand of the Lord has done these things, and the Holy One of Israel has shown them.
verses.41:21: "Your judgment draws near," says the Lord God; "your counsels have drawn near," says the King of Jacob.
verses.41:22: Let them draw near and declare to you what shall come to pass; or tell what the former things were, and we will apply our minds, and we shall know what the last things are; and tell us the things that are to come.
verses.41:23: Declare to us the things coming at the end, and we shall know that you are gods; do good and do harm, and we shall marvel and see together.
verses.41:24: For from where are you, and from where is your work? From the earth! They have chosen you as an abomination.
verses.41:25: But I have raised up the one from the north and the one from the rising of the sun; they shall be called by My name. Let the rulers come, and like potter's clay, and as a potter treads the clay, so you shall be trodden down.
verses.41:26: For who shall declare the things from the beginning, that we may know, and the things beforehand, and we shall say that they are true? There is no one who foretells, nor anyone who hears your words.
verses.41:27: I will give a beginning to Zion, and I will comfort Jerusalem.
verses.41:28: For from among the nations, behold, there is no one, and from among their idols there was none who declared; and if I ask them, "Where are you from?" they shall by no means answer Me.
verses.41:29: For they are those who make you, and in vain are those who lead you astray.
verses.42:1: Jacob, My servant, I will uphold him; Israel, My chosen one, My soul has accepted him; I have put My Spirit upon him; he shall bring forth judgment to the nations.
verses.42:2: He shall not cry out nor slacken, nor shall his voice be heard outside.
verses.42:3: A crushed reed he shall not break, and a smoldering flax he shall not quench, but he shall bring forth judgment for truth.
verses.42:4: He shall shine forth and shall not be broken, until he establishes judgment upon the earth; and in his name the nations shall hope.
verses.42:5: Thus says the Lord God, who made heaven and fastened it, who established the earth and the things in it, and who gives breath to the people upon it and spirit to those who tread upon it:
verses.42:6: "I, the Lord God, have called you in righteousness, and I will take hold of your hand and strengthen you, and I have given you for a covenant of a people,
verses.42:7: to open the eyes of the blind, to bring out from bonds those who are bound, and from the prison house those who sit in darkness.
verses.42:8: I am the Lord God; this is My name; My glory I will not give to another, nor My excellencies to carved images.
verses.42:9: Behold, the things from the beginning have come, and new things I declare; and before they are declared, they have been made known to you."
verses.42:10: Sing to the Lord a new hymn; His dominion—glorify His name from the end of the earth, you who go down to the sea and sail upon it, you islands and those who dwell in them.
verses.42:11: Rejoice, O wilderness and its villages, the encampments and those who dwell in Kedar. Those who dwell in the rock shall rejoice; from the summit of the mountains they shall shout;
verses.42:12: they shall give glory to God; they shall declare His excellencies in the islands.
verses.42:13: The Lord God of hosts shall go forth and crush war; He shall stir up zeal and cry out against His enemies with strength.
verses.42:14: I have kept silent; shall I always keep silent and restrain Myself? Like a woman in childbirth I have endured; I will dismay and dry up at the same time.
verses.42:15: I will lay waste mountains and hills, and dry up all their grass; and I will turn rivers into islands, and dry up pools.
verses.42:16: And I will lead the blind in a way they have not known, and paths they did not know I will make them tread; I will turn darkness into light for them, and crooked places into a straight way. These words I will perform, and I will not forsake them.
verses.42:17: But they turned back. Be put to utter shame, you who trust in carved images, who say to molten images, "You are our gods."
verses.42:18: You deaf, hear; and you blind, look up to see.
verses.42:19: And who is blind except My servants, and who are deaf except those who rule over them? Even the servants of God have been blinded.
verses.42:20: You have seen many times, and did not take heed; the ears were opened, and you did not hear.
verses.42:21: The Lord God purposed that He might be justified and magnify praise.
verses.42:22: And I looked, and the people had become plundered and despoiled; for the snare is in the inner chambers everywhere, and in the houses as well, where they hid them; they became plunder, and there was no one rescuing the spoil, and there was none who said, "Restore!"
verses.42:23: Who among you will give ear to these things? Listen to the things to come,
verses.42:24: to which He gave Jacob for spoil, and Israel to those who plunder him. Was it not God, against whom they sinned, and they were not willing to walk in His ways nor to hear His law?
verses.42:25: And He brought upon them the wrath of His anger, and war prevailed over them, and those who burned them all around; and none of them knew it, nor did they lay it upon their soul.
verses.43:1: And now thus says the Lord God, who made you, Jacob, and who formed you, Israel: "Do not fear, for I have redeemed you; I have called you by your name; you are Mine.
verses.43:2: And if you pass through water, I am with you, and rivers shall not overwhelm you; and if you go through fire, you shall by no means be burned; the flame shall not consume you.
verses.43:3: For I am the Lord your God, the Holy One of Israel, who saves you; I have made Egypt and Ethiopia your ransom, and Syene in your place.
verses.43:4: Since you have become honorable before Me, you have been glorified, and I have loved you; and I will give men in your place, and rulers for your head.
verses.43:5: Do not fear, for I am with you; from the east I will bring your seed, and from the west I will gather you.
verses.43:6: I will say to the north, 'Bring,' and to the south, 'Do not hold back; bring My sons from a land afar off, and My daughters from the ends of the earth,
verses.43:7: all who have been called by My name.' For in My glory I have prepared him, and formed him, and made him,
verses.43:8: and I brought forth a blind people, and their eyes are likewise blind, and they are deaf though having ears.
verses.43:9: All the nations have been gathered together, and rulers shall be gathered from among them. Who will declare these things? Or who will declare to you the things from the beginning? Let them bring forth their witnesses and be justified, and let them hear and speak what is true.
verses.43:10: Become My witnesses, and I also am a witness," says the Lord God, "and the servant whom I have chosen, that you may know and believe and understand that I am; before Me there was no other god, and after Me there shall be none.
verses.43:11: I am God, and beside Me there is no one who saves.
verses.43:12: I have declared and saved; I reproached, and there was no stranger among us. You are My witnesses, and I am the Lord God,
verses.43:13: even from the beginning; and there is no one who delivers out of My hands. I will act, and who shall turn it back?"
verses.43:14: Thus says the Lord God who redeems you, the Holy One of Israel: "For your sake I will send to Babylon and stir up all who flee, and the Chaldeans shall be bound in ships.
verses.43:15: I am the Lord God, your Holy One, who appointed Israel as your king."
verses.43:16: Thus says the Lord, who makes a way in the sea and a path in mighty water,
verses.43:17: who brought forth chariots and horse and a mighty multitude—yet they shall lie down and shall not rise; they have been extinguished like an extinguished wick:
verses.43:18: "Do not remember the former things, and do not ponder the things of old.
verses.43:19: Behold, I am doing new things, which shall now spring forth, and you shall know them. And I will make a way in the wilderness and rivers in the waterless land.
verses.43:20: The wild beasts of the field shall bless Me, sirens and daughters of ostriches, because I have given water in the wilderness and rivers in the waterless land, to give drink to My chosen race,
verses.43:21: My people whom I made My own, to recount My praises.
verses.43:22: Not now have I called you, Jacob, nor have I made you grow weary, Israel.
verses.43:23: Not for Me are the sheep of your whole burnt offering, nor have you glorified Me with your sacrifices, nor have I burdened you with frankincense,
verses.43:24: nor have you bought for Me an offering with silver, nor have I desired the fat of your sacrifices; rather, in your sins you have stood before Me, and in your unrighteous deeds.
verses.43:25: I am, I am He who blots out your iniquities for My own sake, and your sins, and I will not remember them.
verses.43:26: But you, remember, and let us enter into judgment together; declare your iniquities first, that you may be justified.
verses.43:27: Your fathers first, and your rulers, acted lawlessly against Me,
verses.43:28: and the rulers defiled My holy things; therefore I gave Jacob over to destruction, and Israel to reproach."
verses.44:1: "Yet now hear, Jacob My servant, and Israel whom I have chosen,"
verses.44:2: thus says the Lord God who made you, and who formed you from the womb: "You shall yet be helped; do not fear, My servant Jacob, and beloved Israel whom I have chosen.
verses.44:3: For I will give water in thirst to those who walk in a waterless land; I will put My Spirit upon your seed, and My blessings upon your children;
verses.44:4: and they shall spring up like grass in the midst of water, and like a willow beside flowing water.
verses.44:5: One shall say, 'I belong to God,' and another shall cry out in the name of Jacob; and another shall inscribe upon his hand, 'I belong to God,' and shall also cry out in the name of Israel."
verses.44:6: Thus says the King of Israel and He who delivers him, God of Sabaoth: "I am the first and I am after these things; besides Me there is no God.
verses.44:7: Who is like Me? Let him stand and call out and declare, and prepare it for Me from the time I made man forever; and let them declare to you the things that are coming before they arrive.
verses.44:8: Do not hide yourselves nor be led astray. Have you not given ear from the beginning, and I declared it to you? You are witnesses: is there a God besides Me?"
verses.44:9: And they did not hear then. Those who fashion and those who carve are all vain things, making the desires of their heart, which shall not profit them; rather, they shall be put to shame.
verses.44:10: Those who fashion a god and carve it are all unprofitable things,
verses.44:11: and all from whom they came have dried up, and they are deaf among men. Let them all be gathered and stand together, and let them be confounded and put to shame together.
verses.44:12: For the craftsman sharpened iron; with an adze he worked it, and with a drill he set it up, and he worked it with the arm of his strength; yet he shall hunger and grow weak, and shall by no means drink water.
verses.44:13: A craftsman, having chosen wood, set it up by measure, and with glue he shaped it, and made it like the form of a man and like the comeliness of a human being, to set it up in a house.
verses.44:14: He cut wood from the forest which the Lord planted, and the rain caused to grow tall,
verses.44:15: that it might be for men to burn; and taking from it, he warmed himself, and having kindled a fire, they baked loaves upon them; but the rest they fashioned into gods, and they bow down to them.
verses.44:16: Half of it he burned up in the fire, and upon half of it he baked loaves on the coals, and roasting meat upon it he ate and was filled; and having warmed himself, he said, "It is pleasant to me, for I have grown warm and have seen the fire!"
verses.44:17: But the rest he made into a carved god, and he bows down and prays to it, saying, "Deliver me, for you are my god."
verses.44:18: They did not know how to be discerning, for they have been darkened from seeing with their eyes and from perceiving with their heart.
verses.44:19: And he did not consider in his soul, nor did he know in his understanding, that he burned up half of it in the fire, and baked loaves upon its coals, and roasted meat and ate it, and made the rest of it into an abomination, and they bow down to it.
verses.44:20: Know that their heart is ashes, and they are led astray, and no one is able to deliver his soul; look, you will not say, "There is a lie in my right hand."
verses.44:21: "Remember these things, Jacob and Israel, for you are My servant; I have formed you as My servant, and you, Israel, do not forget Me.
verses.44:22: For behold, I have blotted out your iniquities like a cloud, and your sins like a dark mist; return to Me, and I will redeem you."
verses.44:23: Be glad, O heavens, for God has had mercy on Israel; sound the trumpet, you foundations of the earth; shout gladness, O mountains, you hills and all the trees that are in them; for God has redeemed Jacob, and Israel shall be glorified.
verses.44:24: Thus says the Lord, who redeems you and forms you from the womb: "I am the Lord who accomplishes all things; I stretched out the heaven alone, and I established the earth.
verses.44:25: Who else shall frustrate the signs of ventriloquists and divinations from the heart, turning wise men backward and making their counsel foolish,
verses.44:26: and confirming the words of His servant, and proving true the counsel of His messengers? He who says to Jerusalem, 'You shall be inhabited,' and to the cities of Idumea, 'You shall be built,' and her desolate places shall spring up;
verses.44:27: who says to the deep, 'You shall be laid waste, and I will dry up your rivers';
verses.44:28: who bids Cyrus to be wise, and says, 'He shall perform all My desires'; who says to Jerusalem, 'You shall be built, and I will lay the foundation of My holy house.'"
verses.45:1: Thus says the Lord God to My anointed, Cyrus, whose right hand I have grasped, that nations may obey before him; and I will shatter the strength of kings, I will open doors before him, and cities shall not be shut:
verses.45:2: "I will go before you and level mountains; I will crush bronze doors and break iron bars in pieces;
verses.45:3: and I will give you dark, hidden treasures; unseen ones I will open to you, that you may know that I am the Lord God, who calls your name, the God of Israel.
verses.45:4: For the sake of My servant Jacob, and Israel My chosen, I will call you by My name and I will accept you; yet you did not know Me.
verses.45:5: For I am the Lord God, and there is no other besides Me; I strengthened you, and you did not know Me,
verses.45:6: that those from the rising of the sun and those from the west may know that there is none besides Me. I am the Lord God, and there is no other,
verses.45:7: I who fashioned light and made darkness, who makes peace and creates evils; I am the Lord God who does all these things.
verses.45:8: Let heaven rejoice from above, and let the clouds sprinkle righteousness; let the earth spring forth and bring forth mercy, and let it proclaim righteousness together; I am the Lord who created you."
verses.45:9: What better thing have I fashioned, like a potter's clay? Shall the plowman plow the earth all day long? Shall the clay say to the potter, "What are you making, because you do not work, nor do you have hands?" Shall the thing formed answer the one who formed it?
verses.45:10: He who says to a father, "What will you father?" and to a mother, "What are you in labor with?"
verses.45:11: For thus says the Lord God, the Holy One of Israel, who made the things that are to come: "Ask Me concerning My sons, and concerning the works of My hands command Me.
verses.45:12: I made earth and man upon it; I with My hand established heaven; I commanded all the stars.
verses.45:13: I raised him up as king with righteousness, and all his ways are straight; he shall build My city and turn back the captivity of My people, not with ransom nor with gifts," said the Lord of hosts.
verses.45:14: Thus says the Lord of hosts: "Egypt has labored, and the merchandise of the Ethiopians, and the Sabeans, men of tall stature, shall cross over to you and shall be your servants; and they shall follow behind you bound in fetters, and shall cross over to you and bow down to you, and shall pray in you, because God is in you, and there is no God besides You."
verses.45:15: For You are God, and we did not know it, the God of Israel.
verses.45:16: All who oppose Him shall be put to shame and disgraced, and they shall walk in shame. "Be renewed toward Me, O islands!"
verses.45:17: Israel is saved by the Lord with an everlasting salvation; they shall not be put to shame nor be disgraced forever.
verses.45:18: Thus says the Lord who made heaven—this is the God who revealed the earth and made it; He Himself set its bounds, He did not make it in vain, but formed it to be inhabited: "I am, and there is no other.
verses.45:19: I have not spoken in secret, nor in a dark place of the earth; I did not say to the seed of Jacob, 'Seek what is vain.' I am, I am the Lord, who speaks righteousness and declares truth.
verses.45:20: Gather yourselves and come, take counsel together, you who are saved from the nations. They have no knowledge who carry their carved image of wood, and pray to gods that do not save.
verses.45:21: If they will declare it, let them draw near, that they may know together who made these things heard from the beginning; then it was declared to you: 'I am God, and there is no other besides Me, a righteous One and a Savior; there is none apart from Me.'
verses.45:22: Turn to Me and you shall be saved, you from the end of the earth; I am God, and there is no other.
verses.45:23: By Myself I swear—surely righteousness shall go forth from My mouth, My words shall not turn back—that to Me every knee shall bow, and every tongue shall swear by God,
verses.45:24: saying, 'Righteousness and glory shall come to Him, and all who separate themselves shall be put to shame';
verses.45:25: from the Lord they shall be justified, and in God all the seed of the sons of Israel shall be glorified."
verses.46:1: Bel has fallen, Nebo is shattered; their carved images are consigned to wild beasts and cattle; lift them up bound together as a burden for one who is weary,
verses.46:2: faint and hungry, alike without strength, who shall not be able to be saved from war, while they themselves have been led away captive.
verses.46:3: Listen to Me, O house of Jacob, and all the remnant of Israel, who are carried from the womb and instructed from childhood:
verses.46:4: Even to old age I am He, and until you grow old I am He; I bear with you; I have made, and I will forgive; I will carry and save you.
verses.46:5: To whom have you likened Me? Look, contrive, you who go astray,
verses.46:6: who contribute gold from a pouch and silver in a balance; they shall weigh it on a scale, and having hired a goldsmith, they made things crafted by hands, and bowing down, they worship them.
verses.46:7: They lift it upon the shoulder and walk on; and if they set it down, it remains in its place and shall by no means move; and whoever cries out to it, it shall by no means hear, nor shall it save him from evils.
verses.46:8: Remember these things and groan; repent, you who have gone astray; return in heart,
verses.46:9: and remember the former things from of old, for I am God, and there is no other besides Me,
verses.46:10: declaring beforehand the last things before they come to pass, and at once they were accomplished; and I said, "All My counsel shall stand, and all things that I have purposed I will do";
verses.46:11: calling a bird from the east, and from a land far away concerning the things I have purposed; I spoke and I brought it about, I created and I made; I led him and made his way prosperous.
verses.46:12: Listen to Me, you who have lost heart, you who are far from righteousness.
verses.46:13: I have brought My righteousness near, and I will not delay the salvation that is from Me; I have given salvation in Zion to Israel for glory.
verses.47:1: Come down, sit upon the ground, O virgin daughter of Babylon; sit on the ground, O daughter of the Chaldeans, for you shall no longer be called tender and delicate.
verses.47:2: Take a millstone, grind flour; uncover your veil, uncover your gray hairs, bare your legs, cross over rivers;
verses.47:3: your shame shall be uncovered, your reproaches shall appear; I will exact justice from you, I will no longer hand over to men.
verses.47:4: He who delivered you is the Lord of hosts; His name is the Holy One of Israel.
verses.47:5: Sit stunned, enter into the darkness, O daughter of the Chaldeans; you shall no longer be called the strength of a kingdom.
verses.47:6: I was provoked to anger against My people; you defiled My inheritance; I gave them into your hand, yet you gave them no mercy; you made the yoke of the aged exceedingly heavy,
verses.47:7: and you said, "Forever I shall be a ruler." You did not consider these things in your heart, nor did you remember the last things.
verses.47:8: Now therefore hear these things, O delicate one, who sits at ease, who is confident, who says in her heart, "I am, and there is no other; I shall not sit as a widow, nor shall I know bereavement."
verses.47:9: But now it shall come suddenly upon you in your sorcery, in the exceeding strength of your enchantments,
verses.47:10: in the hope of your wickedness. For you said, "I am, and there is no other." Know this: the understanding of these things and your harlotry shall be shame to you; and you said in your heart, "I am, and there is no other."
verses.47:11: And destruction shall come upon you, and you shall by no means know it; a pit, and you shall fall into it; and misery shall come upon you, and you shall by no means be able to become clean; and destruction shall come upon you suddenly, and you shall not know it.
verses.47:12: Stand now with your enchantments and your abundant sorcery, which you learned from your youth, if you shall be able to profit.
verses.47:13: You have grown weary in your counsels; let the astrologers of heaven stand up and save you; let those who gaze at the stars declare to you what is about to come upon you.
verses.47:14: Behold, they shall all be burned up like brushwood on a fire, and they shall by no means deliver their soul from the flame; because you have coals of fire, sit upon them!
verses.47:15: These shall be your help! You have labored in trade from youth; each man has wandered away on his own, and for you there shall be no salvation.
verses.48:1: Hear these things, O house of Jacob, who are called by the name of Israel and have come forth from Judah, who swear by the name of the Lord God of Israel, making mention of Him not in truth nor in righteousness,
verses.48:2: and who hold fast to the name of the holy city, and lean upon the God of Israel—the Lord of hosts is His name.
verses.48:3: The former things I declared even of old; they went forth from My mouth, and they were heard; suddenly I acted, and they came to pass.
verses.48:4: I know that you are stubborn, and your neck is an iron sinew, and your forehead is bronze.
verses.48:5: And I declared to you things of old before they came upon you; I caused you to hear them, lest you should say, "The idols did them for me," and say, "The carved images and the molten images commanded me."
verses.48:6: You have heard all things, and you did not know; yet I have caused you to hear new things from this time forth, which are about to come to pass, and you did not say,
verses.48:7: "Now they come to pass, and not of old." And in former days you did not hear them; do not say, "Yes, I know them."
verses.48:8: You neither knew nor understood, nor from the beginning did I open your ears; for I knew that you would surely act treacherously, and you shall be called a transgressor even from the womb.
verses.48:9: For the sake of My name I will show you My wrath, and My glorious deeds I will bring upon you, that I may not utterly destroy you.
verses.48:10: Behold, I have sold you, not for the sake of silver; yet I have delivered you out of the furnace of poverty.
verses.48:11: For My own sake I will do this for you, for My name is profaned; and My glory I will not give to another.
verses.48:12: Listen to Me, O Jacob, and Israel whom I call: I am the first, and I am forever,
verses.48:13: and My hand laid the foundation of the earth, and My right hand established the heaven; I will call them, and they shall stand together,
verses.48:14: and all of them shall be gathered together and shall hear. Who has declared these things to them? Out of love for you I have performed your will upon Babylon, to take away the seed of the Chaldeans.
verses.48:15: I have spoken, I have called; I have brought him, and I have made his way prosperous.
verses.48:16: Draw near to Me and hear these things: from the beginning I have not spoken in secret; when it came to pass, I was there; and now the Sovereign Lord has sent Me, and His Spirit.
verses.48:17: Thus says the Lord, the Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel: "I am your God; I have shown you how to find the way in which you shall walk.
verses.48:18: And if you had heeded My commandments, your peace would have been like a river, and your righteousness like a wave of the sea;
verses.48:19: and your seed would have been like the sand, and the offspring of your womb like the dust of the earth; nor even now shall you by any means be utterly destroyed, nor shall your name perish before Me."
verses.48:20: Go forth from Babylon, fleeing from the Chaldeans; proclaim a voice of gladness, and let this be heard; declare it to the end of the earth; say, "The Lord has redeemed His servant Jacob."
verses.48:21: And if they thirst, He will bring water for them through the wilderness; out of a rock He will bring it forth for them; a rock shall be split open and water shall flow forth, and My people shall drink.
verses.48:22: "There is no rejoicing," says the Lord, "for the ungodly."
verses.49:1: Listen to me, O islands, and give heed, O nations: "After a long time it shall stand," says the Lord. From my mother's womb He called my name,
verses.49:2: and He made my mouth like a sharp sword, and under the shelter of His hand He hid me; He made me like a chosen arrow, and in His quiver He hid me,
verses.49:3: and He said to me, "You are My servant, O Israel, and in you I shall be glorified."
verses.49:4: And I said, "In vain I have labored; for vanity and for nothing I have given my strength; therefore my judgment is with the Lord, and my labor is before my God."
verses.49:5: And now thus says the Lord, who formed me from the womb to be a servant to Himself, to gather Jacob and Israel to Him—I shall be gathered and glorified before the Lord, and God shall be my strength—
verses.49:6: and He said to me, "It is a great thing for you to be called My servant, to establish the tribes of Jacob and to turn back the dispersion of Israel; behold, I have given you for a covenant of a race, for a light of the nations, that you should be for salvation to the end of the earth."
verses.49:7: Thus says the Lord who redeems you, the God of Israel: "Sanctify him who despises his own life, him who is abhorred by the nations, the servants of rulers: kings shall see him, and rulers shall rise up and bow down to him for the sake of the Lord; for the Holy One of Israel is faithful, and I have chosen you."
verses.49:8: Thus says the Lord: "In an acceptable time I have heard you, and in a day of salvation I have helped you; and I have formed you and given you for a covenant of the nations, to establish the earth and to inherit desolate heritages,
verses.49:9: saying to those in bonds, 'Go forth,' and to those in darkness, to be revealed. Along all the ways they shall be fed, and in all the paths shall be their pasture;
verses.49:10: they shall neither hunger nor thirst, neither shall scorching heat nor the sun strike them; for He who has mercy on them shall comfort them, and through springs of water He shall lead them;
verses.49:11: and I will make every mountain a road, and every path a pasture for them.
verses.49:12: Behold, these shall come from afar; these from the north and the sea, and others from the land of the Persians."
verses.49:13: Rejoice, O heavens, and let the earth exult; let the mountains break forth into gladness; for God has had mercy on His people, and has comforted the lowly of His people.
verses.49:14: But Zion said, "The Lord has forsaken me, and the Lord has forgotten me."
verses.49:15: "Will a woman forget her child, or fail to have compassion on the offspring of her womb? Yet even if a woman should forget these, I will not forget you," said the Lord.
verses.49:16: Behold, upon My hands I have painted your walls, and you are continually before Me;
verses.49:17: and swiftly you shall be built by those by whom you were torn down, and those who laid you waste shall go forth from you.
verses.49:18: Lift up your eyes all around and see them all; behold, they have been gathered together and have come to you. "As I live," says the Lord, "you shall surely put them all on as an ornament, and bind them around you as an ornament, like a bride."
verses.49:19: For your desolate and ruined and fallen places shall now be too narrow because of the inhabitants, and those who swallow you up shall be far away from you.
verses.49:20: For your sons whom you have lost shall say in your ears, "The place is too narrow for me; make room for me that I may dwell."
verses.49:21: And you shall say in your heart, "Who has borne these for me? For I was childless and a widow; and who has brought up these for me? And I was left alone; where were these for me?"
verses.49:22: Thus says the Lord: "Behold, I lift up My hand to the nations, and to the islands I will raise My standard; and they shall bring your sons in their bosom, and your daughters they shall carry upon their shoulders,
verses.49:23: and kings shall be your foster fathers, and their princesses your nurses; upon the face of the earth they shall bow down to you, and they shall lick the dust of your feet; and you shall know that I am the Lord, and those who wait for Me shall not be put to shame."
verses.49:24: Shall anyone take spoils from a giant? And if someone takes captives unjustly, shall he be saved?
verses.49:25: Thus says the Lord: "If someone takes a giant captive, he shall take spoils; and he who takes from a mighty one shall be saved; and I will judge your cause, and I will deliver your sons;
